exposure: Newly diagnosed gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in the 3rd trimester
Suspected large for gestational age (LGA) fetus on ultrasound in the 3rd trimester
cohort: Singleton pregnant women with suspected LGA on 3rd-trimester ultrasound and normal GDM screening results at midpregnancy
finding: Among pregnant women with suspected LGA, 13% were newly diagnosed with GDM in late pregnancy, and while this group had a higher CD rate, there were no significant differences in other perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the group newly diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) compared to the non-GDM group, though this was primarily driven by an increase in cesarean deliveries on maternal request.
